entities.summary: Michael Fakuade is an American-Nigerian basketball player for Real Estelí of the BSN. Standing at 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m), he primarily plays as power forward. Fakuade is a two-time BAL champion, having won the title in 2021 with Zamalek and in 2023 with Al Ahly.
